default_route: default via 10.77.0.17 dev eth0 proto static

firewall_raw.iptables:
-P INPUT ACCEPT
-P FORWARD DROP
-P OUTPUT ACCEPT
-N DOCKER
-N DOCKER-BRIDGE
-N DOCKER-CT
-N DOCKER-FORWARD
-N DOCKER-INTERNAL
-N DOCKER-USER
-A FORWARD -j DOCKER-USER
-A FORWARD -j DOCKER-FORWARD
-A DOCKER -d 172.18.0.3/32 ! -i br-03897529915b -o br-03897529915b -p tcp -m tcp --dport 443 -j ACCEPT
-A DOCKER -d 172.18.0.3/32 ! -i br-03897529915b -o br-03897529915b -p tcp -m tcp --dport 80 -j ACCEPT
-A DOCKER -d 172.18.0.2/32 ! -i br-03897529915b -o br-03897529915b -p tcp -m tcp --dport 8888 -j ACCEPT
-A DOCKER ! -i docker0 -o docker0 -j DROP
-A DOCKER ! -i br-03897529915b -o br-03897529915b -j DROP
-A DOCKER-BRIDGE -o docker0 -j DOCKER
-A DOCKER-BRIDGE -o br-03897529915b -j DOCKER
-A DOCKER-CT -o docker0 -m conntrack --ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
-A DOCKER-CT -o br-03897529915b -m conntrack --ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
-A DOCKER-FORWARD -j DOCKER-CT
-A DOCKER-FORWARD -j DOCKER-INTERNAL
-A DOCKER-FORWARD -j DOCKER-BRIDGE
-A DOCKER-FORWARD -i docker0 -j ACCEPT
-A DOCKER-FORWARD -i br-03897529915b -j ACCEPT
-A DOCKER-USER -s 100.21.4.152/32 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 8888 -m comment --comment "kz_gateway: allow forward proxy from 100.21.4.152" -j RETURN
-A DOCKER-USER -s 100.21.4.153/32 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 8888 -m comment --comment "kz_gateway: allow forward proxy from 100.21.4.153" -j RETURN
-A DOCKER-USER -s 100.21.0.10/32 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 8888 -m comment --comment "kz_gateway: allow forward proxy from 100.21.0.10" -j RETURN
-A DOCKER-USER -s 100.21.0.4/32 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 8888 -m comment --comment "kz_gateway: allow forward proxy from 100.21.0.4" -j RETURN
-A DOCKER-USER -s 100.21.0.2/32 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 8888 -m comment --comment "kz_gateway: allow forward proxy from 100.21.0.2" -j RETURN
-A DOCKER-USER -p tcp -m tcp --dport 8888 -m comment --comment "kz_gateway: deny forward proxy from anywhere else" -j DROP
